title: Windows account lockout - Event ID 4740
source: LogVigil original training note (not an official Microsoft, MITRE, or NIST publication)
text: Windows Security Event ID 4740 records an account lockout. A SOC analyst can correlate the account, timestamp, and caller computer with failed logons such as Event ID 4625. A lockout alone does not prove malicious activity. Review evidence and request human approval before any response action.
